description: What sets a group of events APART from the rest of the log: the field=value pairs over-represented in the selection. E.g. of 300 errors, 92% have `version=2.4.1` against 4% of everything else — the deploy that broke it, found without reading 300 errors. Select by minimum level (default: errors), by text, or by one field=value; that selector is left out of the answer, since it would trivially top it. Fields that are unique per event (request ids, trace ids) are skipped: they identify, they do not distinguish. A difference in proportions, not causation.

contains.description: Select events whose raw text contains this (case-insensitive)

format.description: Force the format instead of detecting it

from.description: Which end to read if the file is over 32 MB

minLevel.description: Select events at this level or above (default "error" if nothing else is given)

path.description: Path to the log file. Use this for big logs: they do not fit in a tool call.

text.description: The log as text. Alternative to `path`.

name: log_distinguish
